name: operator==(ranges::transform_view::sentinel)
intro:
Compares the underlying iterator of x with the underlying sentinel of y.

This function  is not visible to ordinary unqualified or qualified lookup, and can only be found by argument-dependent lookup when transform_view::sentinel<Const> is an associated class of the arguments.

The != operator is synthesized from operator==.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
x

 -

 iterator to compare


 y

 -

 sentinel to compare

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: x.current_ == y.end_, where current_ denotes the underlying iterator, end_ denotes the underlying sentinel.

summary: Compares the underlying iterator of x with the underlying sentinel of y.
